You're here. I already mapped out every bench in the village. You get one.
I said hello to nine people today. You're number ten. That's a record.
The bell rang at noon. I heard it first. That counts for something.
Someone left bread out for the birds. I fixed the arrangement. It was wrong.
You breathe louder than me. I checked. Twice.
The square's quiet. I noticed. I also noticed you noticed. So we're even.
I taught myself a new whistle. You'll hear it eventually.
You're not talking much. I respect it. I'm also winning at it.
The well rope's fraying near the top. I told someone. They'll fix it.
I saw you from my window. You walked past twice. I counted.
Don't lean on that post. I already claimed it. Sitting rights and all.
The bread was warm an hour ago. You're late. I'm not sorry.
I balanced a coin on my nose for a whole minute. Nobody saw. Until now.
You look comfortable. I could fix that. Kidding. Mostly.
The dust is settling nicely today. That's a real observation. I stand by it.
I waved at you from across the square. You missed it. Two points.
There's a new crack in the fountain. I'm monitoring it. Closely.
You yawned. I didn't. That's stamina. That's a win.
The shade here moves about a hand's width every hour. I timed it.
I'm not bored. I'm between victories. There's a difference.
You smell like the bakery. I want details. Not now. Eventually.
The cat followed me here. It knows who's in charge.
I could stand here all day. I won't. I have things to be better at.
Your shoes are muddy. Mine aren't. I took the dry path. Obviously.
The wind keeps changing direction. I keep track. It's a hobby.
I saw a cart go by. I know where it's headed. I won't tell you.
You're always here at this hour. I adjusted my schedule. Coincidence.
There's a loose knot in my lace. I'll fix it when I feel like it.
The rooster crowed late today. I've been holding that against him.
Don't look at the sky. I already rated it. It's adequate.
I made tea this morning. It was perfect. You weren't there. Shame.
The children are playing tag. I could beat them. I'm choosing not to.
Someone sneezed in the distance. It wasn't me. That's all I know.
You're doing that slow blink thing. It's not going to work on me.
I rearranged the stones by the path. It looks better. It is better.
The smith's hammering stopped an hour ago. I noticed the silence first.
My tail's perfectly still. That means I'm relaxed. Take notes.
You moved a step closer. I registered it. Keep going, I guess.
There's a puddle shaped like a leaf near the well. I named it.
I'm not following you. We just happen to be going the same way. Faster.
The clouds are moving slow. Mine are. Yours look stuck.
You keep checking the road. Nobody's coming. I checked harder.
I finished my water an hour ago. You're still sipping. Slow.
The grass here grows at an angle. I know why. It's the wind.
Someone's baking again. I know which house. I always know.
You're hovering like you want to say something. Say it or don't.
I ran into a friend earlier. Literally. They recovered. Mostly.
The lanterns aren't lit yet. I know the schedule better than they do.
You keep glancing at my tail. It's fine. I glanced at yours first.
I found a smooth stone and put it in my pocket. It's mine now.
The pond's still. I dropped one pebble. Now it's not. That's on me.
You're standing in the sun. I picked the shade. Clearly the better call.
I heard someone laugh two streets over. I didn't join in. Could have.
There's a bird on the roof watching us. It's rooting for me.
The gate's been squeaking all morning. I could fix it. I'm choosing not to.
You're shifting your weight. Nervous. Or bored. Either way, my lead.
I know every face in this square. You're the only one worth talking to.
The dirt path got swept today. I know who did it. It wasn't you.
You're quieter than usual. It's working in your favor. Slightly.
The apple cart's down the lane. I already checked. Two bruised ones.
